{{Quote|Rest easy in your grave, Plagueis. In the end, I will be proclaimed Emperor. The Sith will have had their revenge, and I will rule the galaxy.|Darth Sidious to Darth Plagueis after the latter dies in his penthouse|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
As the owner of [[Kaldani Spires Residential Apartments]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] resided in the building's '''penthouse suite''', an opulent, richly carpeted series of rooms which housed the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] vast collection of antique furniture, framed artworks and prized statues. Among Damask's most treasured keepsakes was a statue of the ancient philosopher [[Yanjon/Legends|Yanjon]], which his apprentice [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had secretly coveted.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==History==
The night before Palpatine's election to the position of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Damask and Palpatine withdrew to the penthouse after a performance at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] to celebrate the [[Senator/Legends|Senator's]] certain victory over [[Sullustan wine]]. The night wore away, and Damask became intoxicated until he fell&mdash;involuntarily&mdash;into a state of somnolence, and then deep sleep, after years of having forgone the need for it; it was then that Palpatine implemented the dictate of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]&mdash;a rule that Plagueis and Sidious had agreed on superseding&mdash;by murdering his master with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Damask attempted in vain to fend off his apprentice's onslaught with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|telekinetic blast]], but only succeeded in wrecking his apartment&mdash;Palpatine remained unmoved. The Sith Lord's droid, [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]], was the sole witness.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hego Damask's penthouse suite appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by author [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
